sources: Sources: Reuters, CBC, NBC News, AA

scenes.text: Yemen's Houthis say they hit Saudi Arabia's biggest oil refinery

scenes.head: Ras Tanura
scenes.body: The group says the strike caused fires. Satellite images showed thick black smoke over the site.

scenes.label: drones intercepted
scenes.sub: says the Saudi-led coalition, which has not confirmed damage to the refinery

scenes.label: people wounded
scenes.sub: in a strike on a tower in Riyadh's financial district, the second hit on that tower in under a week

scenes.head: What's next
scenes.body: Oil prices jumped after the claim. The coalition vows a firm response, and the Houthis threaten more attacks.

scenes.text: Russia fires a wave of ballistic missiles and drones at Ukraine

scenes.label: missiles and drones downed
scenes.sub: by Ukraine's air defences overnight, officials say

scenes.head: Kharkiv
scenes.body: A drone hit a residential high-rise, killing two. A third person died in a strike on an educational building.

scenes.label: killed across Ukraine
scenes.sub: at least, with 58 injured during the day, according to Suspilne

scenes.head: The backdrop
scenes.body: It follows Putin's vow to retaliate for Ukrainian strikes on Russian energy sites.

sources: Sources: Syrian state media via The National

scenes.text: ISIS attackers strike a security building in north-east Syria

scenes.head: Hassakeh
scenes.body: The target was an internal security building, Syrian state media reports.

scenes.label: security officers killed
scenes.sub: and five more injured in the assault

scenes.label: attackers dead
scenes.sub: two in clashes with security forces, two in suicide explosions, officials say

scenes.head: Why it matters
scenes.body: ISIS cells remain active in north-east Syria, carrying out repeated attacks on security forces.

sources: Sources: AP, hospital officials in Gaza

scenes.text: Israeli strikes kill eight Palestinians in Gaza

scenes.label: killed overnight
scenes.sub: according to hospital officials in Gaza

scenes.label: killed the day before
scenes.sub: in separate Israeli strikes, reports say

scenes.head: The truce
scenes.body: A ceasefire has been in place since October 2025, but deadly strikes keep testing it. Israel says past strikes answered militant attacks.

scenes.head: Watch for
scenes.body: Whether mediators can stop the near-daily violence from unravelling the deal.

sources: Sources: ECDC, WHO, UNICEF, Africa CDC

scenes.label: confirmed cases

scenes.label: deaths
scenes.sub: since the outbreak began in May 2026

scenes.label: of cases are children

scenes.head: Not under control
scenes.body: Africa CDC says conflict, late detection and stretched clinics are slowing the response to the Bundibugyo strain.
